lots.guide_summary: All 8 surviving entries are SOLD hammer prices at Gowans in AUD (no conversion), listed Oct 2025 to Sep 2026: $90 to $350, with most at $100 to $160. The one same-brand sale (Samick Strat copy with amp, stand and bag) made $152. Only a Squier-branded hard-case Strat reached $350. No UNSOLD or ASKING entries.
lots.working: Keep: lowest same-item SOLD price is the Samick Strat copy at $152 hammer (Oct 2025, within 24 months). 152 / 1.198 = 126.9, rounded down to $125 hammer ($149.75 all-in). Flip: likely resale about $150, local sale on Marketplace or Gumtree with no fee and no postage (posting a guitar in a hard case costs about $40-60 and would wipe out the margin). (150 - 0) / 2.396 = 62.6, rounded down to $60 hammer. Inbound freight $0 (pickup from Moonah).
lots.confidence_reason: Samick read on the headstock and one good same-brand SOLD entry (page opened, photo checked), backed by six close budget-Strat sales. Model, year and playing condition unknown, so not High.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped as not the same item or tier (all were genuine Gowans records, prices and dates matched): 1990s Fender Stratocaster MIM $420 (genuine Fender, much higher tier); Fender Squier Telecaster with hard case $290 (different model); CB Sky Strat-style $50 and Strat Style Sonik $45 (very low-end toys, not comparable); Cort Les Paul style with hard case $320, Epiphone Studio LP $300, Ibanez GAX70 $230, Washburn electric $400 (different brands and body styles, category only).
lots.question_for_gowans: Does it play and does the electronics work (all pickups, switch, volume and tone pots, output jack)? Is the tremolo arm included? Any neck warp, fret wear, cracks or dings, and do the hard case latches all close? Any model or serial number on the neck plate or headstock back?
lots.key_photo_findings: Samick script logo on a natural-finish Strat-type headstock with six-in-line tuners; sunburst body, white three-ply pickguard, three single-coil pickups, two-point tremolo bridge, rosewood fretboard with dot inlays. Black tolex hard case with plush lining, latches present. No visible damage at photo resolution; no tremolo arm visible.
lots.condition: Appears clean and complete in the single photo; case in good order. Playability, electronics and fret condition unseen.

lots.working: Keep: no exact same-item sale; lowest close Franz piece SOLD is the boxed centrepiece bowl at $70 hammer (Aug 2026). 70 / 1.198 = 58.4, rounded down to $55 hammer ($65.89 all-in). Conservative because our group has three pieces. Flip: likely resale about $140 for the group (low end of single-piece Gowans prices; buyers paid $84 to $168 all-in), selling on eBay at about 13% fees and $25 fragile postage: 140 x 0.87 - 25 = 96.8; 96.8 / 2.396 = 40.4, rounded down to $40 hammer.

lots.question_for_gowans: Please check the bases for the Franz Collection mark and any model numbers, and look closely for chips or restoration on the hummingbird beak, wings and tail, the iris petals, the swan necks and the bulrush tips. Are there any boxes?
